one_line: One headline held all the way, a changing line per use, and a joke ending on a grown-up using it.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 an empty bright living room, a rocking chair, no speech. A BLISS box appears at 0:01, a woman cuts it open at 0:02. Text from 0:00: 'POV:' then 'מצאת את המתנה המושלמת שמתאימה לכל הגילאים'.
q1_hook.why: A gift promise for every age is on screen from frame zero, and the box arriving and being opened gives a reason to wait (T3, H5, K7). But the first second is an empty room (H1), and the product shows only as a box until 0:06, with no voice or face (H4, S1).

beats.what: Empty living room, a rocking chair; the headline is already up
A BLISS box appears, a dog passes, she cuts the tape
beats.why: A real delivery, a small gag with the dog.

beats.what: She drags out the wrapped product; a small line 'גם משחקי דימיון לדוגמא- דוכן גלידה'
beats.why: The reveal, and the first extra use.

beats.what: A baby climbs the arch and steps, then stands at a window; 'גם מדרגות'
beats.why: Use one, shown on a child.

beats.what: A baby crawls through the arch toward the lens, then close; 'גם מנהרה'
beats.why: Use two ends on a face looking at the lens.

beats.what: A woman rocks a baby on a rocker piece; 'גם נדנדה'
She sits on a sofa with a laptop on the arch, feet through it; 'ואפילו מעמד למחשב 🤣'
beats.why: The gag payoff: an adult uses it.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. The caption has four bullets (rocker, tunnel, steps, an ice-cream stand), and a joke about adults; it asks nothing.
q2_flow.why: 'גם ... גם ... ואפילו' sets a list, with a new child and room for each use, so every 4 to 6 s is new (R3, K2). The adult-on-a-sofa gag lands in the last 5 s (R4, K3). At 27 s it fits a demo (R2). It stays on the gag to the end, no tail (R1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption: 'אז אפשר להפסיק לחפש, כי מצאתי את המתנה המושלמת!', bullets of uses, 'קיצר, חסכתי לכם את כל ההתלבטויות!'. No link, code, price, brand tag in the text, or comment word.
q3_cta.why: The gift line is a conclusion, not an action, and nothing says where to buy: no brand name on screen (the box only), no link or price (C6, C3). No question or reason to send it to a friend, though a gift idea invites it (R5).

q4_shown.what: A BLISS box 0:01; the wrapped piece pulled out 0:06; babies on arch and steps 0:07 to 0:12; crawling through the arch 0:13 to 0:19; a rocker 0:20; the arch as a laptop stand 0:21 to 0:26. No price. Caption's ice-cream stand not shown.
q4_shown.why: Different children and rooms show one piece in several uses (S1, K5). The first sight of the product itself is at 0:06 (S1). The box logo is the only brand cue (H3). Babies' faces show (S5). The caption lists two uses not seen.

q5_edit.what: 12 shots in 26 s (2.2 s each): a static take for 6.7 s, then clips of different children and rooms, 1 to 7 s each. One persistent headline plus a changing small line. No sound the transcript shows. Ends on a held gag shot.
q5_edit.why: The long first take sets up a real delivery, then clip cuts with a new line each time keep the list moving (R3, E2). The held headline keeps the promise in view (T3). The long hold on the gag lets the joke land (K3). It stops there (E8).

q6_topic.what: A foam arch set as a gift for every age: steps, tunnel, rocker, and a laptop stand. Serves a gift buyer or a parent wanting one set for the family.
q6_topic.why: A gift that fits all ages answers a real decision, 'what do I give' (K7, K6), and the adult-uses-it gag adds a smile (K3, K1). The 'proven by adults too' joke comes from home life, not a gag out of nowhere (K3).

q7_filmed.what: Phone, mostly static, eye level, wide: a fixed frame for the unboxing in a sunlit living room; babies in other rooms, one low shot from inside the tunnel, one close at the lens; a top-down on the rocker; a fixed wide shot on a sofa.
q7_filmed.why: A locked frame lets the box and product read (F7, F4). A low shot from inside the tunnel puts the viewer in the product's place (F5). Clips from different rooms look mixed and real (H8). The headline sits in the upper half (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: A persistent two-part headline in white bold sans-serif with a dark shadow, centred at about 12 to 30% of the frame height, in the upper third, all 26 s: 'POV:' then 'מצאת את המתנה המושלמת שמתאימה לכל הגילאים'. Below it a small changing line at about 30 to 36%: 'גם משחקי דימיון לדוגמא- דוכן גלידה' (0:07), 'גם מדרגות' (0:08), 'גם מנהרה' (0:13), 'גם נדנדה' (0:20), '🤣 ואפילו מעמד למחשב' (0:21).
q8_text.caption: 'אז אפשר להפסיק לחפש, כי מצאתי את המתנה המושלמת! 😍' Then 'הכירו את ה-להיט שמתאים לכל שלב ולכל גיל:' and four bullets of uses, a line about friends and adults, 'חסכתי לכם את כל ההתלבטויות!'. About 70 words. No hashtags, tag, CTA or disclosure.
q8_text.why: A big headline in the first second states the promise, short enough to read, inside the top of the frame (T3, T4, T5). It works muted (T1). The caption repeats the pitch and names the uses, but has no brand tag, hashtags or disclosure word (T7, T8, S7).

weak_points: No price, store or CTA; no disclosure word beside a listed co-author; an empty first second; the product itself appears only at 0:06; the caption lists uses (ice-cream stand) not shown; different children from other homes, which Yarin cannot copy.
lumebook_takeaway: A held 'POV:' headline, the parcel opened, one changing line per feature, ending on the funniest use. Hands and the book, no child needed.
not_verified: Whether the clips of other babies are from the creator's home or from others (they are in different rooms). Music (none evident). Whether the paid label applies (0, none seen). Correction: the first second is an empty room; the box appears at 0:01 and the headline is up from 0:00. A small line 'גם משחקי דימיון לדוגמא- דוכן גלידה' also appears at 0:07.
